description: Boundary coverage for client identification: an empty-string client identifier is treated like no identifier at all (direct invalid_client / 'No client id supplied'), while a non-empty but unregistered identifier (here whitespace-only) is reported as an invalid client id. Both surface as direct, non-redirect client errors before any redirect can occur.

status=400

body.error=invalid_client
body.error_description=No client id supplied

body.error_description=The client id supplied is invalid
